Separate authoritative committed effects from speculative presentation and define replacement/cancellation semantics. Reuse the actual T20.03 learner reducer adapter and storage.pages snapshot backend, then vary compiler/endianness and compare canonical state hashes. Implement a hidden wall-clock/random dependency as a deliberately failing counterexample, not a production change.
